scenes.title: YOU FALL INTO A BLACK HOLE
scenes.say: You fall into a black hole. What actually kills you?

scenes.title: PAUSE AND GUESS
scenes.say: Burn, stretch, or freeze? Pause and guess.

scenes.sub: Yes, that's the real science word
scenes.say: It's B. You stretch. Scientists really call it spaghettification.

scenes.title: Gravity gets stronger the closer you get
scenes.say: Gravity gets stronger the closer you get.

scenes.title: Your feet get pulled way harder than your head
scenes.say: Fall in feet first, and your feet get pulled way harder than your head.

scenes.title: Pulled long. Squeezed thin.
scenes.say: So you get pulled long and squeezed thin. Like spaghetti.

right.title: GIANT
right.verdict: Cross the edge, feel almost nothing

scenes.say: Here's the twist. A small black hole stretches you before you even reach the edge. A giant one? You cross the edge and feel almost nothing.

scenes.label: after you cross the edge
scenes.src: NASA simulation of Sagittarius A*, the giant black hole in our galaxy
scenes.say: In NASA's simulation of the giant one in our galaxy, it's over about thirteen seconds after you cross.

scenes.title: WHICH ONE WOULD YOU FALL INTO?
scenes.say: Small or giant, which would you fall into? Comment small or giant. Part four: can anything ever escape?
